name: Datadog Bits AI
bestFor: AI incident investigation and root-cause analysis for teams already standardized on Datadog
description: Datadog's AI agent that investigates incidents, correlates telemetry, chats over observability data, and proposes fixes — sold as a credit-based add-on to an existing Datadog subscription.

freeTier.limits: Available only as an add-on to a paid Datadog subscription — no standalone free tier

paidTier.notes: AI Credits from $500/month for 500 credits on an annual commitment, or $1.30 per credit on demand; credits reset monthly and don't roll over. Rough usage: ~0.5 credit per chat message, ~4 per autonomous investigation, ~5 per code fix. Requires an underlying Datadog plan, priced separately.

name: PagerDuty (AIOps)
bestFor: On-call incident response with AI-driven noise reduction and event correlation
description: Incident response and on-call management with an AIOps add-on that correlates and de-duplicates alert noise into actionable incidents, plus an AI-assisted status page and automation suite.

freeTier.limits: Free plan for up to 5 responders

paidTier.notes: Professional $21/user/month (annual) or $25/month (monthly); AIOps, PagerDuty Advance and other AI features are separate add-ons. The PD Reliability Platform is a separate platform-fee product: Starter $2,800/year (10 seats, 5,000 Signal Intelligence events, 1,000 AI actions), Essential $12,000/year (20 seats, 40,000 events, 4,000 AI actions), Plus $48,000/year (50 seats, 150,000 events, 16,000 AI actions), Ultimate custom (500 seats).

name: Harness (AIDA)
bestFor: AI-assisted CI/CD, cloud cost management, and infrastructure-as-code in one modular platform
description: A software delivery platform (CI/CD, feature flags, cloud cost management, IaC) with AIDA, its built-in AI assistant, included even on the free tier.

freeTier.limits: Free plan for individual developers and small teams (Harness Open Source, Chaos, community support)

paidTier.notes: Essentials (bundled CI, CD, IaC and security, up to 500 users) and Enterprise (any modules, unlimited users, premier support) are both quote-based — no per-developer price is published. Multi-year commitments are reported to earn 15–30% discounts.
